scope: pointer ownership grammar across the landing and the authenticated application

vocabulary.native-hiding: html[data-sheet-cursor='live'] gates cursor:none on .landing; ladder restores crosshair below 992px where no local instrument is initialized

/.owner: SheetCursor (square instrument) — the app-level CursorManager is suspended for the whole route (RoutedCursorManager, App.tsx)
/.glyph: 9px filled orange square + velocity trail (movement-dependent, vanishes on first still frame)
/.interactive: 24px square outline reticle over a/button/[role=button]/input/select/textarea/label/summary; contracts to scale .56 / opacity .68 while pressed

suppressed-zones..bp-stage: hero inspection — the local 8x8 plus with bounded guides + scene-relative coordinates owns the pointer at >=992px; below 992px the native crosshair returns (no dead zone)
suppressed-zones..sl: entrance loader — its own cross + X/Y readout own the pointer at every width while it plays

/.footer: the square global pointer remains authoritative; the lens is a separate image-reveal effect, never a second cursor

other routes (auth, shell, public /colle.owner: CursorManager (R305-A2 additive layer) — unchanged by R311
other routes (auth, shell, public /colle.glyph: circular dot/ring decoration over the untouched native cursor (the app layer never hides the OS pointer)

fallbacks.touch-or-coarse: both custom systems gate down; the native pointer is the only glyph
fallbacks.reduced-motion: both custom systems gate down (single RM source in each); the native pointer is the only glyph; the landing stands complete without the loader
fallbacks.instrument-failure: native-hiding is gated on data-sheet-cursor='live' (present only while the square instrument is actually live) — any failure degrades to the native cursor; the app layer never mounts if JS dies

lifecycle-guarantees.initial-entry: the move handler owns the reticle state (R311 D2 fix) — a pointer entering straight onto a link shows the reticle immediately
lifecycle-guarantees.route-transitions: suspension flips with the router; the pipeline tears down (no stale glyph) and re-subscribes on return
lifecycle-guarantees.native-link-drag: documented browser landmine (R311 D3): during a native drag the pointer stream is swallowed — no custom system can track; not an app defect
lifecycle-guarantees.idle: the square system unsubscribes ~8 frames after settle; the trail vanishes on the first still frame

evidence.after-gate-a: audits/evidence/r311/after/ (DOM audit: cursorLayerCount 0 in every state)
integration-tests: frontend/tests/motion/r311-cursor-ownership.test.tsx (7 specs, jsdom + real router + real landing)
